First Aid Basics

Quick reminders. Always call emergency services for serious injuries.

Minor Cuts

Clean with water. Apply pressure. Cover with sterile bandage. Change daily.

Burns

Cool with running water 10–20 min. Don't ice. Cover loosely. No butter.

Sprains

Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation (RICE). Avoid heat first 48 hours.

Choking

5 back blows, 5 abdominal thrusts. Alternate until object clears.

When in doubt, call for help. Better safe than sorry.

user_requests: how do i pour a rosetta
instances.html:
Milk & Latte Art

Morning, user_name. The milk knows if you're nervous. (Coffee beans get their own log — this one's about texture.)

Steam Target

60°Cstop by 65

Stretch Time

3–5 s of air, then bury the tip and swirl.

Pitcher

Fill to the spout's base — half is plenty for a 6 oz cup.

Milk

Whole, cold (4°C). Oat works, but stretches fast.

  1. Anchor: pour high and thin to set the canvas.
  2. Lower: tip near the surface, start the wiggle.
  3. Finish: lift and draw a clean line through.
Why the foam kept splitting
  • Steamed too long — above 70°C the proteins give up.
  • Forgot to swirl before pouring. Big bubbles ruin everything.
  • Poured too fast. Slow is smooth, smooth is art.

Best rosetta yet on Tuesday. Frame it, honestly.
